title: diag ring: report/GET concurrent access is unsynchronized (torn event reads)
description: Pre-existing, surfaced by ldzz.3 codereview (out-of-scope note): lichen/subsys/lichen/diag/lichen_diag.c has no synchronization between writers (lichen_diag_report from any subsystem thread) and the CoAP GET /diag reader (diag_get copies a 48-byte struct while a concurrent report can overwrite the same slot — torn reads). The lora_l2_tx caller path is mutex-serialized but arbitrary future reporters are not. Fix options: (a) add a K_MUTEX_DEFINE(s_ring_mutex) around report/get/count; (b) make the ring lock-free with a sequence counter (seqlock pattern); (c) document single-writer constraint. Given the ring is diagnostic-only, (a) is simplest — the struct copy under mutex is short. Severity low (torn diagnostic reads mislead humans, do not crash), but should be fixed before the ldzz detector family lands, since those reporters run in radio/GPS thread contexts.
